release_notes: Build 55 adds a targeted recovery for installations whose project path migrated correctly but whose LocalAppData database remained empty.
The recovery finds the richest legacy FactVault database using project-library, quiz-question, quiz-history and upload-journal records rather than accepting an empty bootstrap database.
An installed database is replaced only when it contains zero meaningful user rows; any existing installed user data is never overwritten automatically.
Before recovery the installed database is backed up, the legacy database is copied through SQLite's verified backup API, and recovered record counts are checked before startup continues.
Recovered project, Quiz History and managed question-image paths are rebased to the persistent LocalAppData projects and data folders.
The YouTube Manager playlist cache is copied when available, while Analytics, upload history and published-video links are restored from the recovered database.
The legacy development database and project files remain untouched so the development folder should only be removed after the installed Library and YouTube Manager are verified.
